subject: general
question: If a student scored 18.75 marks out of 25, what is the fraction in simplest form?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Multiply both numerator and denominator by 4 to eliminate the decimal.

18.75 × 4 = 75

25 × 4 = 100

Fraction = 75/100 = 3/4

**∴ The correct answer is 3/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Obtained value = 18.75, Total value = 25

Formula: Fraction = Obtained Value ÷ Total Value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b23b8cfaa35f3628c670b9d2324a7c0f2a54e9aca8cecf516cecf070507da586.png] 

⇒ Required Fraction = 18.75 / 25

⇒ Multiply numerator and denominator by 100 to remove decimals: 1875 / 2500

⇒ Divide both by 25: 75 / 100

⇒ Divide both by 25 again: 3 / 4

**∴ The correct answer is 3/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simplest Form of a Fraction

A fraction is in its simplest form when the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of the numerator and denominator is 1.

Fraction to Percentage

To convert any fraction into a percentage, multiply it by 100. Example: 3/4 × 100 = 75%.

Decimal Removal Rule

To remove a decimal with two places, multiply both the numerator and denominator by 10² (i.e., 100).
